draft.title: Economic change and cities
card: The industries in a city can grow or close. When they do, jobs, people and land use in the city change.
If a main industry closes, such as a steelworks or a car factory, jobs can be lost. People may move away, shops may close and the area can decline.
Old industrial land can be reused. Urban renewal is when an old area is rebuilt, for example as new housing, offices and parks.
When new industries grow, such as technology or services, they can bring jobs and new building to a city.
draft.remember: Industries growing or closing change a city. Urban renewal rebuilds old areas.

a.q: A city turns an old shipyard into apartments and offices. What is this called?
a.why: Rebuilding an old area for new uses is urban renewal. Decline is the opposite: it is what can happen when industries close and nothing replaces them.
a.clue: The old land is being rebuilt for new uses.

b.q: A car factory in a town closes and 3000 workers lose their jobs. What is a likely effect on the area?
opts: Some people move away and shops lose customers
Jobs rise quickly as more workers arrive
The area is certain to be rebuilt as offices
b.why: Losing a major employer can reduce spending and push people to leave, so decline is likely. Urban renewal can happen later, but it is not certain.
b.clue: Think about what happens when many workers lose pay.

b.best: Some people move away and shops lose customers
